title: tetrataenium aquilegifolium
intro: Tetrataenium aquilegifolium, commonly known as the Kashmir spindle tree or Chinese fumewort, is a plant species belonging to the family Brassicaceae. It is valued for its health benefits, which include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The plant is said to exhibit therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Tetrataenium aquilegifolium include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
